cell.label: Is patient at high risk, low risk with symptoms, or is screening mandated by law*?
Identify and remove environmental lead exposures, order CBC, and peripheral smear.
Avoid occupational exposures. Stabilize lead-based paint and replace building components.
Chelation therapy for children and symptomatic adults. Strict avoidance of exposures.
Hospitalization for chelation therapy and expert consultation.

footnotes.footnote: *Children enrolled in state or federal health care programs may require routine screening.
Adapted from Committee on Environmental Health. Screening for elevated blood lead levels. Pediatrics 1998;101:1072–1078.
